QuestInfo.name: John's Testimony
QuestInfo.parent: Information about the Slumbering Dragon Island
QuestInfo.0: Go see #p0020000#, author of the #t4161051#. #b#p0020000##k lives in #b#m104000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p0020000# says that he indeed who wrote the Voyage Log and that not a single word of it is exaggerated. When you ask #p0020000# about the location of the island that is mentioned, he gives you a map that shows where it is. Can you find a ship willing to go there? Go see #b#p1002001##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1002001# says that he can't sail to this Island...

0.0: Are you here to buy a fish? Huh? #t4161051#...? Well, of course I wrote it! But I've retired long ago... What? You want to know whether what I wrote is true?
0.1: Do I look like I need embellish stories to make them interesting? Of course it's all true! Even the bit about the island I where found a sleeping dragon. But why do you ask? You're not trying to get to that island, are you?
0.2: Haha, another youngling acting with reckless bravado... I'd urge you to play it safe, but I suppose you must learn that on your own. Alright, I'll give you a map to the island.

yes.0: Since you're not a crew member, find #b#p1002001##k near the ticketing booth and ask him if you can go to this island. The sea route will be rough, so he may decline your request.

no.0: Don't need this map? Smart choice. Don't put yourself in danger for some ridiculous ambition.

1.0: That whale there is getting on my nerves. I probably shouldn't catch it though, huh? What are you doing here? Hm? You want to know if you can get to the island on this map? Let me see...

yes.0: This place...should only be approached by a competent crew member. The waves out there are very choppy. You can easily capsize and hurt yourself. I don't know if even I have the skill to navigate through there...

npc.0: Have you gone to see Teo yet? He might be able to help you get to the island on the map.

item.0: That whale there is getting on my nerves. What is it? Don't bother a crew member if you don't have much to say.

lost.0: I thought you were a strong adventurer, but you are indeed a novice. You dropped the map. Here, take it.
